properties.name: 4736a
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
properties.notes: Former industrial site that is vacant following clearance of the last derelict buildings. Predominantly hardstanding and grassed areas remain. Offers a good opportunity for redevelopment in the urban area, with scope to provide a residential scheme in an attractive waterfront location. A planning permission was previously consented for scheme of 49 two- three- and four-bed dwellings but this has now lapsed (15/01941/FUL). This was for part of this wider area of land (4736a), Adjacent land remains occupied and utilised for industrial/commercial purposes and is neither suitable or available for residential development (4736b, 4736c). The immediate availability of the site is uncertain. It is considered to still have potential in the longer-term, but residential development is forecast later in the plan period.
